rules.admission: geometry_valid in the geometry record and every hard check of the floor-free measurement passed
rules.common_grid: the finest mesh of the case; coarser designs are nested-copied (integer factors)

distances.L1: mean |rho - rho'| of the gray fields over the design domain
distances.xor: fraction of design-domain elements whose clean binary state differs

rules.not_claimed: no optimality of the subset; q_source is never compared across springs; HF evaluation pending
rules.quality: floor-free q_free under the comparison profile (start of the selection and the performance floor)
rules.selection: greedy maximin on the xor distance from the best-quality eligible candidate; stop at k=6 or when the best remaining distance is below min_distance=0.05
